risk_factors.heading: A drop in the market share and changes in product mix offered by our customers can impact our revenues.
risk_factors.quote: We are dependent on the continued growth, viability and financial stability of our customers. Our customers generally are OEMs in the automotive industry.

risk_factors.heading: Our business in China is subject to aggressive competition and is sensitive to economic and market conditions.
risk_factors.quote: Maintaining a strong position in the Chinese market is a key component of our global growth strategy. The automotive technology and components market in China is highly competitive

risk_factors.heading: Our business in China is subject to aggressive competition and is sensitive to economic and market conditions.
risk_factors.quote: Our business in China is sensitive to economic and market conditions that drive automotive sales volumes in China and may be impacted if there are reductions in vehicle demand in China.

risk_factors.heading: We operate in the highly competitive automotive technology and component supply industry, and are dependent on the acceptance of new product introductions for continued growth.
risk_factors.quote: As a result, our sales levels and margins could be adversely affected by pricing pressures from OEMs and pricing actions of competitors.

risk_factors.heading: We operate in the highly competitive automotive technology and component supply industry, and are dependent on the acceptance of new product introductions for continued growth.
risk_factors.quote: If we do not continue to innovate to develop or acquire new and compelling products that capitalize upon new technologies, this could have a material adverse impact on our results of operations.

risk_factors.heading: If we do not respond appropriately, the evolution of the automotive industry towards autonomous vehicles and mobility on demand services could adversely affect our business.
risk_factors.quote: The high development cost of active safety and autonomous driving technologies may result in a higher risk of exposure to the success of new or disruptive technologies different than those being developed by us.

risk_factors.heading: We have invested substantial resources in markets and technologies where we expect growth and we may be unable to timely alter our strategies should such expectations not be realized.
risk_factors.quote: we may not only fail to realize expected rates of return on our existing investments, but we may incur losses on such investments and be unable to timely redeploy the invested capital
